Shanice: Here we are!
Bot: Why are there heat signatures lurking in the shadows? Are people here shy?
You: N-No, I don’t think so…
You: Shanice, please take us to that place so we can get it done as fast as possible.
Shanice: Sorry, my sense of direction is really bad. Let’s ask some locals for directions!
You: No.
You: {f_botName}, could take us there?
Bot: No problem.
